first-contact-hope.name: Steady the Flame
first-contact-hope.premise: A grey band circles you at the edge of the firelight, wavering between approach and flight.
first-contact-hope.loop: Your flame breathes on its own; holding space feeds it, releasing lets it fade. Each nomad drifts inward only while the light sits inside their comfort — too bright and the nearest flinch back, too dim and the farthest turn away. The correct move is usually to do less.
first-contact-hope.signals: Brightness is the flame itself; each nomad's comfort shows in their posture — leaning in, shielding their eyes, or turning; commitment shows as kneeling.
first-contact-hope.outcome_win: Those who reach you kneel and take your color deeply; the fire settles.
first-contact-hope.outcome_fail: A flare or a fade; the flinchers freeze grey, ringed in your color, and the rest scatter.
first-contact-hope.why_fun: Restraint under temptation — the urge to feed the flame is the trap, and the skill is modulation, not action.
first-contact-hope.gdd_quote: commit only if the flame is steady when they arrive

first-contact-fear.name: The Scatter
first-contact-fear.premise: The band breaks at your roar and runners peel off along every open line.
first-contact-fear.loop: For a few strides you are faster than they are. Each runner flees along a visible line toward the dark; you cut lines by moving through them. You cannot reach every line — every step toward one runner opens another's escape.
first-contact-fear.signals: Escape routes read as the runners' own paths and the gaps between rocks; a runner you head off stops dead and cowers; an escaped runner shrinks into the dark still carrying the story.
first-contact-fear.outcome_win: Everyone you head off turns shallowly to your color, trembling.
first-contact-fear.outcome_fail: The ones who escape spread the tale of you outward to camps you have never seen.
first-contact-fear.why_fun: Chase geometry as instant triage — commitment costs are visible the moment you move, and you cannot catch everyone by design.
first-contact-fear.gdd_quote: you have a handful of strides to cut off the runners

vigil-hope.name: The Weaving
vigil-hope.premise: Sleep takes you; your believers hang in the dark as points of your color.
vigil-hope.loop: With your last stamina you draw a thread from believer to believer with slow movements. The thread holds only while your pace stays gentle and your turns stay wide; a rushed segment frays and snaps. Longer chains reach further and are harder to hold.
vigil-hope.signals: The thread is drawn light between bodies; fraying shows as the thread thinning and trembling; a completed chain settles into a steady channel glow.
vigil-hope.outcome_win: Completed chains carry belief between the sleepers all generation.
vigil-hope.outcome_fail: A snapped thread leaves its two ends dark; unchained believers stand alone against the grey.
vigil-hope.why_fun: The ambition tradeoff — every extra link is reach you want and risk you must hold with smoother hands.
vigil-hope.gdd_quote: Completed chains become channels belief travels while you are gone

vigil-fear.name: The Watch (marked)
vigil-fear.premise: Your believers are points of light and the dark presses in from every side.
vigil-fear.loop: You hold a shadow-shield over one cluster at a time while the dark gnaws at every unshielded light. A text label marks who is safe and who is fading, and you drag coverage between clusters as the pressure shifts.
vigil-fear.signals: A text label over each cluster reads SAFE or FADING so the player always knows the state.
vigil-fear.outcome_win: Dawn arrives with the clusters you chose still burning.
vigil-fear.outcome_fail: The lights you abandoned are grey by morning, standing exactly where you left them.
vigil-fear.why_fun: Triage under guaranteed loss — the skill is deciding what to lose, and living with it.
vigil-fear.gdd_quote: You shield what you can and you cannot shield everything

holding-hope.name: The Procession (stormer)
holding-hope.premise: A rooted settlement resists you everywhere but along your own roads.
holding-hope.loop: You charge down your road at full speed, slamming through the gate before the residents can react, and shove as many as possible toward the heart in the seconds before the ring closes. The more you force through at once, the more turn.
holding-hope.signals: The road carries your color; residents knocked aside sprawl; the ring closing shows as doors and shoulders turning inward.
holding-hope.outcome_win: Everyone you shoved to the heart flips to your color at once.
holding-hope.outcome_fail: The ring closes and ejects you; the settlement hardens.
holding-hope.why_fun: Speed and force — hitting the gap hard before it shuts.
holding-hope.gdd_quote: Roads are the only way in

holding-fear.name: The Breaking (v1)
holding-fear.premise: The settlement's resistance shows as a ring around it, thick where belief runs deep.
holding-fear.loop: Strike the ring where it is thinnest; each strike hardens the arcs beside it. Find the collapsing sequence before your stamina runs out.
holding-fear.signals: Arc strength reads as the ring's thickness and glow; a struck arc cracks; hardened arcs brighten.
holding-fear.outcome_win: The ring collapses and the settlement lies open.
holding-fear.outcome_fail: Stamina spent, the ring reseals thicker than before.
holding-fear.why_fun: A sequencing puzzle wearing an action skin — reading the structure matters more than hitting it.
